verdict.rationale: The only export-adjacent evidence is programmatic access. The SDK lets you query and filter spans (docs-30), and the /mcp endpoint can query traces and datasets (docs-58). Self-hosting keeps data in your own infrastructure (docs-27). Getting that data into blob storage or a warehouse would mean writing your own pull-and-load code. Missing for 10: a documented bulk-export feature for traces and datasets, native blob-storage or data-warehouse connectors and export formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
